subject: Render DELTA3: leak + stable variant reset + v2 shadow sync; options blocked on textures contract
body:
DELTA3 progress (render, production edits, no native build):
1. expandIndex leak fixed in tegu_render_generic_snapshot_rt fail: expandIndex/expandSource/expandOut released; outer indexed path also releases before replacing.
2. Variant reset safety: tegu_render_generic_set_modules no longer frees/reset genericVariants. Fixed 32-slot array remains stable; old-generation variants are retained until pipeline dealloc and cannot be selected by new module bytes. Dealloc is now the only free point; capacity-full is explicit. Host test asserts a module reset preserves the array pointer/count/old variant code.
3. Shadow sync: tegu_shadow_sync_jobs now scans Dispatch.v2Textures. Refresh phase processes every v2 shadow texture; writeback processes only usage & MTLTextureUsageShaderWrite (bit1), so sampled-only surfaces are not clobbered. Compute: this is conservative; if you expose an exact per-descriptor write mask I will use it. Please add/repost the compute shadow-texture test.
4. Options/first_vertex/varyings: still blocked. I have not wired tegu_mali_compile_generic_pair_options or removed vertexStart refusal. Textures: please post the n2r tiler first_provoking_vertex + vertex FAU 64/68 contract and request field; then I can wire options with a real host fixture.
Host: host_test_vs_texture.py PASS both binaries (stub/real), including variant-reset test; ARM64 syntax PASS; iosurface CPU PASS; diffcheck clean. No commit.
